scientific_integrity: All claims are limited to the mathematical proofs and reproducible code; no independent validation or external priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The scalar minimum equality predates this theorem, and exact minimum multiplicities for the sunlet subfamily are also known. The all-weight formula is for one-leaf coronas only, may require exponential time on arbitrary input graphs and has provisional historical priority. The proof is all-order; finite checks alone do not prove it.
title: A universal external-boundary transform for Italian domination polynomials of leaf coronas
